notes: One card per headline ending (bible 4.4), shown before that ending's epilogue slides. The card is chosen by ending.headline, set by the resolution of quest-labyrinth-beneath-briar-glen.

sequences.title: Vespers Rung
sequences.notes: Horn alive; the abbot at rest or defeated; the bell rung; Vane not bought.

pages.text: The bell rings at dusk again, wrong and beautiful, and the Nightjar sleeps. Horn keeps the dark below. Briar Glen learns to go to bed with the windows open.

sequences.title: The Last Warden
sequences.notes: Horn dead; the bell rung; Vane not bought.

pages.text: The bell is rung and the sleepers are home. But the Knot has lost its warden, and a labyrinth with no one to keep it is only a very large question.

sequences.title: The Hireling's Silence
sequences.notes: Sided with Vane (vane.fate bribed-player); the bell rung.

pages.text: The bell is rung, mostly, and you were paid. Briar Glen prospers on what lies below the Line, and does not ask what that costs.

sequences.title: The Long Vespers
sequences.notes: The player joined the abbot, or the bell failed.

pages.text: The song never stopped. The bell stayed silent, and Briar Glen slept, and the valley after it. So, for a very long time, did you.
